# Load-time imports of limusic-app.exe on Windows (dumpbin /DEPENDENTS), checked by
# scripts/check-windows-imports.ps1 in windows-release.yml and checks.yml. One DLL per line,
# compared case-insensitively; '#' starts a comment.
#
# Taken from the 1.3.0-rc.4 release, built with the tauri CLI (STATIC_VCRUNTIME=true, so the VC
# runtime is linked statically and only the UCRT api-ms-win-crt-* sets are imported). Every DLL
# here is part of Windows except libmpv-2.dll, which ships next to the exe.
#
# A new entry means every user's machine must have that DLL for the app to START, karaoke or not.
# Karaoke's ONNX Runtime, DirectML, D3D12/DXGI and the C++ runtime are deliberately NOT here: they
# are loaded at run time, by full path, only when karaoke is turned on. Do not add them.
# No delay-load section is allowed either.
#
# Some entries come from Rust's std rather than from this repo (e.g. bcryptprimitives.dll and
# api-ms-win-core-synch-l1-2-0.dll). CI and releases both build with the current stable toolchain
# (`rustup default stable-msvc`), so a Rust release can change this list without any change here.
# If the check fails on a PR that touched no dependency, build the same commit with the previous
# stable toolchain and compare: if only std-provided DLLs differ, update this list in a separate,
# deliberate commit; if a DLL from a dependency appears, that is what this check exists to catch.
advapi32.dll
api-ms-win-core-synch-l1-2-0.dll
api-ms-win-core-winrt-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-convert-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-environment-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-heap-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-locale-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-math-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-multibyte-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-runtime-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-stdio-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-string-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-time-l1-1-0.dll
api-ms-win-crt-utility-l1-1-0.dll
bcrypt.dll
bcryptprimitives.dll
combase.dll
comctl32.dll
crypt32.dll
dbghelp.dll
dwmapi.dll
gdi32.dll
kernel32.dll
libmpv-2.dll
ntdll.dll
ole32.dll
oleaut32.dll
secur32.dll
shell32.dll
shlwapi.dll
user32.dll
winmm.dll
ws2_32.dll
